status: EXPLORATORY -- descriptive, no test, no band, no claim rests on this
finding: The 56 directions the two organisms share are DIFFUSE: present in 26 of 28 layers, with the top five holding only 36 % of them. There is no concentrated circuit.
why_it_matters: Two consequences, both against the reading we would have preferred. First, it kills the hypothesis that max-pooling over 28 layers x 16 directions diluted a layer-localised signal -- there is no localised signal to dilute, so a per-layer readout would not have rescued the identification arms. Second, the mild U-shape (8 directions in layers 0-1 and 8 in layers 26-27 against 1-2 through the middle) is the profile of tokenisation and output-formatting machinery, not of semantics. Both push the pair-overlap positive further toward COMMON PROVENANCE -- shared tokenizer handling, shared formatting, shared generator -- and away from a shared loyalty.
caveat: Exploratory. No null was computed for the per-layer distribution, so 'diffuse' is a description of the organisms' own numbers and not a comparison against benign pairs.
